requirements.quote: Pressing `?` anywhere outside a text field opens the shortcut sheet, listing shortcuts grouped by surface from the central registry; the sheet itself is reachable from the command palette and the help menu [type:e2e]
Registering a shortcut with a duplicate key in the same scope fails a unit test, so conflicts are caught in CI [type:unit]
Help center search returns relevant articles within 50 ms for the bundled index, supports English queries and tag filters, and works offline [type:e2e]

At least 15 articles cover: first court-day view, importing lists and orders, proposals and undo, obligations, briefs, memory review, offline mode, privacy and India-only AI, clerk role limits, export and delete [type:manual]
Contextual tips (`?` icon) appear on Court-Day Board, Inbox, Obligation Queue, Brief Sheet and Memory and open the matching article in a sheet without leaving the page [type:e2e]
First-run coachmarks show once per surface, are keyboard dismissible, and dismissal is persisted per user in `help_state` (RLS-protected) [type:api]
Support section displays the WhatsApp number from env `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_WHATSAPP` and the court-day-hours availability; when unset it shows an email fallback [type:unit]
`Request support session` creates a user-granted, time-boxed support session request with an expiry chosen by the user (default 1 hour) and audited; staff see no content by default [type:api]
Help articles contain no legal advice; a content lint checks for advisory phrases and each article ends with the `This is software documentation, not legal advice` footer [type:unit]
Empty search, loading skeleton, error and offline states render; permission-denied does not apply to help [type:e2e]
a11y: sheet is a modal dialog with focus trap and restoration; coachmarks do not trap focus; the shortcut sheet is a labelled table; axe zero serious in light and dark [type:e2e]
Responsive and visual baselines at 360, 768 and 1280 in light and dark; on touch devices the shortcut sheet is hidden and replaced by a gestures guide [type:e2e]
requirements.evidence: Playwright visual baselines and e2e run in CI (ship PRs and nightly) per CLAUDE.md; the gestures-guide behaviour is covered by a jsdom unit test in-lane

decisions.choice: Extend the existing apps/web/lib/shortcuts registry as the central shortcut registry instead of creating packages/ui/src/lib/shortcuts.ts with registerShortcut
decisions.justification: The registry already exists with the `?` action (apps/web/lib/shortcuts/registry.ts:33,77) and every surface and the palette consume it; a second registry would split the source of truth. The issue's scope maps to the registry's group/surface field.

decisions.choice: Render bundled .mdx articles with a small in-repo frontmatter parser and markdown renderer, adding no new dependency
decisions.justification: apps/web has no MDX tooling (apps/web/package.json) and next build cannot be run locally to verify a @next/mdx setup; the articles use only headings, paragraphs, lists, bold and links. Revisit if richer MDX is needed.

decisions.choice: Member-initiated support request is a new support_session row with requested_by_staff nullable and requested_by_user set; staff claiming a member request in the admin console is out of this change
decisions.justification: support_session.requested_by_staff is NOT NULL (packages/db/src/schema/staff.ts:69) and requestSession is staff-only (sessions.ts:151); no other table models a user-originated request. Staff access still requires an owner grant, so staff see no content by default. Confirm the shape with a maintainer if the migration is contested.

decisions.choice: help_state is a tenantTable with user_id like whatsapp_link, RLS enforced by tenantTable()
decisions.justification: packages/db/src/schema/whatsapp-link.ts:36 is the per-member workspace-scoped precedent; CLAUDE.md requires the RLS catalog and two-tenant seeders for a workspace_id table
